name: krafty-sprouts/pollen
label: Pollen
description: Shares your content to social networks when it is published, on a plan you set, and by re-sharing older items. It sends only to the networks you connect, and tracks no readers.

jobs.label: Pollen: refresh sign-ins and tidy up
Pollen: plan shares for this item
Pollen: switch sharing for this item

settingsSections.label: Getting started
settingsSections.description: Pollen keeps each channel's sign-in sealed with this key. Set it once, before you connect any channel.

settingsSections.label: Your apps on the networks
settingsSections.description: The networks that need an app of your own give you these keys when you make one. Pollen's README says where.

settingsSections.label: Sharing
settingsSections.description: How shares are written, timed and tagged.

settingsSections.label: Images
settingsSections.description: Which image goes with a share, and how Pollen prepares copies of it.

settingsSections.label: Servers you choose
settingsSections.description: Mastodon servers, Bluesky servers and WordPress sites your channels post to.

settingsSections.label: AI and notices
settingsSections.description: Captions from your site's AI connection, and when to tell people about problems.

settings.label: Lock key
settings.description: A long phrase, at least 24 characters, that seals channel sign-ins. Changing it later means connecting every channel again.

settings.label: Meta app ID
settings.description: For Facebook Pages and Instagram: the App ID of your app at developers.facebook.com.

settings.label: Meta app secret
settings.description: That app's App Secret.

settings.label: Threads app ID
settings.description: The Threads App ID shown under your Meta app's Threads use case.

settings.label: Threads app secret
settings.description: The Threads App Secret.

settings.label: X client ID
settings.description: The OAuth 2.0 Client ID of your app at developer.x.com.

settings.label: X client secret
settings.description: That app's OAuth 2.0 Client Secret.

settings.label: LinkedIn client ID
settings.description: The Client ID of your app at linkedin.com/developers.

settings.label: LinkedIn client secret
settings.description: That app's Primary Client Secret.

settings.label: Pinterest app ID
settings.description: The App ID of your app at developers.pinterest.com.

settings.label: Pinterest app secret
settings.description: That app's secret key.

settings.label: Reddit client ID
settings.description: The ID under your web app at reddit.com/prefs/apps.

settings.label: Reddit client secret
settings.description: That app's secret.

settings.label: Google client ID
settings.description: For Google Business Profile and Blogger: an OAuth client ID from console.cloud.google.com.

settings.label: Google client secret
settings.description: That OAuth client's secret.

settings.label: Tumblr consumer key
settings.description: The OAuth consumer key of your app at tumblr.com/oauth/apps.

settings.label: Tumblr secret key
settings.description: That app's secret key.

settings.label: Plurk app key
settings.description: The App Key of your app at plurk.com/PlurkApp.

settings.label: Plurk app secret
settings.description: That app's App Secret.

settings.label: Share text
settings.description: What a share says unless a network, a channel or the writer says otherwise. Use {title}, {excerpt}, {content}, {link}, {author}, {hashtags}, {categories}, {tags}, {site} and {type}.

settings.label: Text for each network
settings.description: Write differently for a network. A network not listed uses the share text above.

fields.label: Network
fields.description: The network this text is for.

fields.label: Text
fields.description: The template for this network.

fields.label: First comment
fields.description: Posted under the share where the network allows it, such as {link} on Instagram.

fields.label: Most hashtags
fields.description: How many of the item's terms become hashtags here.

settings.label: Most hashtags
settings.description: How many of an item's categories and tags become hashtags.

settings.label: Wait after publishing
settings.description: Minutes Pollen waits after an item is published before sharing it, so a quick fix makes it in.

settings.label: Tag shared links
settings.description: Add utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign to each shared link, so your own statistics can tell where readers came from.

settings.label: utm_source
settings.description: Use {network} and {channel}.

settings.label: utm_medium
settings.description: Use {network} and {channel}.

settings.label: utm_campaign
settings.description: Use {slug}, {id}, {type} and {network}.

settings.label: Pause all sharing
settings.description: While on, nothing is sent; shares wait and go when it is off again.

settings.label: Image for a share
settings.description: Teme doesn't yet tell plugins an item's featured image, so Pollen uses the first image in the article, unless the writer chose one.

options.article: The writer's choice, else the article's first image
options.chosen: Only an image the writer chose

settings.label: Where your images are
settings.description: The address your site's images are served from, such as https://media.example.com. Pollen fetches images only from here to prepare copies.

settings.label: Prepare copies for each network
settings.description: Resize and crop a copy of the image to each network's best size. The original is never changed.

settings.label: Add a watermark
settings.description: Place your logo in a corner of each copy.

settings.label: Logo address
settings.description: The address of a PNG of your logo.

settings.label: Corner
settings.description: Where the logo sits.

settings.label: Logo width
settings.description: The logo's width as a share of the image's.

settings.label: Servers
settings.description: One address a line: each Mastodon server, Bluesky server other than bsky.social, and WordPress site a channel posts to.

settings.label: Offer AI captions
settings.description: Let writers ask your site's AI connection for share text. Nothing is posted until a person chooses it, unless an automation says so.

settings.label: Caption voice
settings.description: How AI captions sound.

settings.label: Tell managers after
settings.description: Failed shares in a row on one channel before the people who manage Pollen are told.

actions.label: Check every channel
actions.description: Asks each network whether its channel's sign-in still works.

permissions.label: Share with Pollen
permissions.description: Share items to the channels they may use, plan shares and see their own.

permissions.label: Manage Pollen
permissions.description: Connect channels, write automations, see every share and Pollen's reports.

notices.label: Email me when a Pollen channel must be connected again
Email me when a Pollen channel keeps failing
Tell me when a share I planned fails

aiTasks.label: Pollen share captions
aiTasks.description: Writes share text for each network from an item's title and words.

hooks.name: ShareRequests
hooks.description: Asked each minute for items other plugins want Pollen to share.

hooks.name: ShareText
hooks.description: Lets other plugins change a share's text before it is sent.

hooks.name: ShareSent
hooks.description: Tells other plugins a share was sent or failed for good.

editorPanels.label: Pollen
editorPanels.description: Share this item to your channels, now or later.

fields.label: When (such as 2026-12-01 09:30; empty for when it is published)

area.label: Shares
area.description: Your channels, planned and sent shares, and the automations that share for you.

blocks.text: Add a channel, then open the address in its Sign-in column to connect it. Networks that use a token connect as soon as you save.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: What you call this channel in Pollen, such as “Garden club page”.

fields.label: Account
fields.description: Which page, board, chat, subreddit, location or blog to post to. Leave it empty to choose after connecting, when the account has more than one.

fields.label: Labels
fields.description: Words that group channels, separated by commas, such as “news, weekend”. A writer can name a label to share to every channel with it.

fields.label: Share new items of these types
fields.description: Share each newly published item of these types here. Leave empty to share only by hand and by automations.

fields.label: Server
fields.description: For Mastodon, a WordPress site, or a Bluesky server other than bsky.social: its address, which must also be listed under Servers in Settings › Pollen.

fields.label: Handle or user name
fields.description: Bluesky: your handle, such as name.bsky.social. WordPress: the user name the application password belongs to.

fields.label: Token
fields.description: Telegram: the bot token. Bluesky and WordPress: an app password. Mastodon and VK: an access token. Discord: the webhook address. Pollen seals it and never shows it again; leave it empty to keep the saved one.

fields.label: Text
fields.description: This channel's own template. Empty uses the network's text, or Pollen's.

fields.label: First comment
fields.description: Posted under each share where the network allows it.

options.card: As a link preview, where the network makes one

fields.label: Network option
fields.description: Reddit: the flair ID. Mastodon: unlisted or private to post there instead of publicly. Telegram: silent to send without a sound. Blogger and WordPress: draft to save as a draft.

options.sharers: Everyone who may share with Pollen
options.listed: Only the people named below, and managers

fields.label: People
fields.description: Display names or account numbers, separated by commas.

fields.label: Item
fields.description: A published item's address or ID. Leave it empty to post your own message, such as an announcement.

fields.label: Text
fields.description: Empty uses the template for each channel.

fields.label: Image address
fields.description: An image to post with it, from where your images are served.

fields.label: Channels
fields.description: Channel names or labels, separated by commas; empty for every channel you may use. Saving plans one share for each.

fields.label: When
fields.description: Empty sends it in the next minute.

options.publish: When a matching item is published
options.reshare: Again and again, from older items

fields.label: Channels
fields.description: Channel names or labels, separated by commas.

fields.label: Text
fields.description: Empty uses each channel's own.

fields.label: Let AI write each share
fields.description: Ask your site's AI connection for the text, and send it without a person choosing it.

fields.label: Types
fields.description: Empty means posts.

fields.label: In these categories
fields.description: Category slugs, separated by commas; empty for any.

fields.label: With these tags
fields.description: Tag slugs, separated by commas; empty for any.

fields.label: Never in these
fields.description: Category or tag slugs, separated by commas.

fields.label: Never these items
fields.description: Item IDs or addresses, one a line.

fields.label: Older than
fields.description: Days since first published; 0 for no limit.

fields.label: Newer than
fields.description: Days since first published; 0 for no limit.

fields.label: On these days
fields.description: Empty for every day.

fields.label: Not before
fields.description: Hour of the day, in the site's time zone.

fields.label: Not after
fields.description: Hour of the day, in the site's time zone.

fields.label: Share an item again after
fields.description: Days; 0 waits until every matching item has been shared.

fields.label: Take turns
fields.description: Send each pick to the next channel in turn, rather than to every channel.

author: Krafty Sprouts Media, LLC
